name: Autopilot Device Name
description: Autopilot device-name template. Hard limit: 15 characters total — Windows enforces it AFTER %SERIAL% / %RAND:n% macros expand at enrollment, so keep static text well under budget. Allowed characters: letters, numbers, hyphens. Note: this app checks allowed characters and typed length, and also flags templates whose %RAND:n% expansion would exceed the 15-character limit — you must still ensure the final name is not all numbers.

patterns.name: Prefix + Serial
patterns.description: Static prefix plus the %SERIAL% macro (e.g. DT-%SERIAL%)

patterns.name: Custom Template
patterns.description: Free-form template mixing static text and macros

fields.name: Prefix
fields.tip: Letters, numbers and hyphens only. Static text counts toward the 15-character limit — %SERIAL% expands to the real serial at enrollment, so leave room.

fields.name: Macro
fields.tip: Pick the macro from the list to avoid typos; custom macro strings are allowed. Macros expand AFTER the app checks your name against the 15-character limit.

fields.name: Template
fields.tip: Mix static text and macros (%SERIAL%, %RAND:n%). Count every character as typed — %SERIAL% is 8 characters today but grows at enrollment. The name may not be all numbers; this is not checked automatically.
